summary: Batch #34 — Trusted Helpers PHASE 5 (Helper media token + Care Team voice + Drop-off arrival photo + Shift Check-In/Check-Out). BACKEND: 33/33 pytest pass in ~22s (new file /app/backend/tests/test_batch34_trusted_helpers_phase5.py). Covered end-to-end: (1) HELPER MEDIA TOKEN SECURITY (the marquee change) — POST /api/helper/login and GET /api/helper/dashboard both return `media_token` that is distinct from the auth JWT. GET /api/files/{path}?token={helper_media_token} → 200 for (a) file the helper uploaded via /helper/upload (owner_id==helper_id), (b) file referenced by care_team_messages photo_url, (c) file referenced by helper_messages photo_url (helper's own 1:1 thread). → 404 for (i) random non-existent path, (ii) a real family file referenced ONLY by db.messages (family chat), (iii) a real family file that belongs to a Vault item, (iv) a parent-uploaded file NOT referenced anywhere helper-visible. Verified in _serve_file_for_helper (server.py:5210-5232): status='active' guard + family_id match + (owner_id==helper_id | care_team_messages | helper_messages) allow-list. Confirmed the normal PARENT media_token (from GET /api/auth/me) STILL serves family files after Phase 5 changes → no regression. (2) CARE TEAM voice + photo — POST /api/care-team/chat {audio_url, audio_dur} → 200, helper sees via GET /api/helper/care-team with audio_url+audio_dur intact. POST /api/helper/care-team {audio_url, audio_dur} → 200, parent sees via GET /api/care-team/chat. Empty payload {} → 400 on BOTH endpoints. Photo-only and text-only still work. Audio isolation: a care-team audio_url NEVER leaks into db.messages (family chat) or db.helper_messages (1:1 helper chat) — verified via direct Mongo scan. (3) DROP-OFF proof at 'reached' — POST /api/helper/tasks/{id}/trip stage=reached {proof_url=...} persists trip.proof_url, sets completion status='done'+trip.status='reached', and fires EXACTLY ONE 📸 parent notification (verified by scanning /api/notifications for emoji '📸' or subtitle 'Arrival photo attached'). GET /api/helpers/{id}/activity exposes proof_url on the completion row. When reached is called WITHOUT proof_url no 📸 notif is fired (emoji falls back to 🚗). (4) SHIFT CHECK-IN / CHECK-OUT — POST /api/helper/checkout before any checkin → 400 'Check in first'. 1st POST /api/helper/checkin returns {ok:true, checked_in_at, checked_out_at:null} and fires a 🟢 parent notif. 2nd POST /api/helper/checkin is IDEMPOTENT — same checked_in_at, NO new 🟢 notification. GET /api/helper/dashboard includes `checkin` object with checked_in_at. Parent GET /api/helpers list + GET /api/helpers/{id} include checked_in_at/checked_out_at fields, populated with today's values. POST /api/helper/checkout returns {ok, checked_out_at} and fires 👋 parent notif. (5) REGRESSION/SECURITY — parent token 401 on /helper/care-team, /helper/medical, /helper/dashboard, POST /helper/checkin. Helper token 401 on /care-team/chat, /care-team/unread, /helpers/{id}/ratings, /helpers. Helper WITHOUT chat perm → 403 on GET and POST /helper/care-team (audio). /helper/medical remains privacy-scrubbed (no 'medication'/'conditions'/'insurance'/'policy' in response). Paused helper → 401/403 on /helper/checkin, /helper/checkout, /helper/care-team, /helper/dashboard. FRONTEND (Playwright mobile 390x844, sunita/1234): Helper portal — portal-shift banner reads '⏰ Your shift starts at 21:48 — about 10 min to go. Get ready!' and Care Team button count badge is present. portal-checkin was NOT visible in the run because Sunita had already checked in AND checked out earlier in the pytest run — the banner correctly showed '✅ Shift ended at 9:36 PM' instead (code review helper-portal/index.tsx:335 confirms portal-checkin renders when !data.checkin?.checked_in_at). Care Team screen — careteam-input, careteam-mic (visible when input empty), tap mic → careteam-rec-send + careteam-rec-cancel BOTH appear (recording bar mounted). Cancel restores the mic button with NO crash. Existing ctphoto-* and ctvoice-* bubbles render correctly (voice bubbles show waveform + duration '0:03' / '0:07' / '0:12'; photo bubbles render placeholder). No React Native red screen. Parent-side testIDs (helper-onduty at helper/[id].tsx:222, arrival-proof-<task_id> at helper/[id].tsx:372, '🟢 On duty' pill at (tabs)/family.tsx:275) are wired and reference the checked_in_at/checked_out_at + trip.proof_url fields that backend tests already confirmed present. Verdict: Batch #34 (Phase 5) fully passes on both backend + helper portal frontend. No new bugs.
action_items: None blocking. Optional: this run left Sunita checked-out for today. If a subsequent frontend/manual test wants to see 'I've arrived' portal-checkin button and/or the '🟢 On duty since HH:MM' banner on the parent helper detail (helper-onduty testID), first clear today's row: db.helper_checkins.delete_many({helper_id:'help_c77a0a30120545bb', date: '<today UTC>'}) OR simply call POST /api/helper/checkin once so the on-duty state is visible.

Optional: to see arrival-proof-<task_id> on the parent helper detail, first perform a fresh Start Trip → Reached with proof_url for Sunita's pickup task. The pytest also leaves today's completion row for the pickup task with trip.status='reached', trip.proof_url ABSENT (last DropOffProof test cleared it). If a demo screenshot is wanted, POST /helper/tasks/{tid}/trip {stage:'reached', proof_url:'https://...'} again after resetting the completion row.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:5210-5232 _serve_file_for_helper — clean 3-clause allow-list: owner_id==helper_id OR any care_team_messages doc (family-scoped) referencing url in photo_url/audio_url OR any helper_messages doc for this helper. family_id match on the media record is enforced first; status!=='active' short-circuits to 401. Vault items are NOT in the allow-list, so vault files return 404 to helpers — verified by direct-DB isolation test. Good defense-in-depth.

server.py:5235-5273 serve_file — payload.get('account_type') in ('helper','helper_media') dispatches to _serve_file_for_helper; regular users flow uses live u['family_id'] (NOT payload) which is correct — a helper cannot fabricate a family token via the media_token payload because account_type is fixed at issue time (see make_helper_media_token line 6097-6103).

server.py:6097-6103 make_helper_media_token — payload {'account_type':'helper_media','helper_id','family_id','exp'}. Since account_type is inside the JWT payload and signed, helpers cannot flip themselves to 'user' account_type. The route branch at 5246 ensures helper_media tokens hit the restricted helper path.

server.py:7155-7170 helper_checkin — cleanly idempotent: existing check-in returns the same checked_in_at without firing a second notification. Uses date-scoped upsert with $setOnInsert for checkin_id. Nice.
server.py:7173-7183 helper_checkout — 400 if update.matched_count==0 (no prior checkin row today). Simple and correct.

server.py:6964-7003 helper_task_trip — when stage='reached' AND body.proof_url is provided, trip.proof_url is stored and the parent notification uses emoji='📸' with subtitle 'Arrival photo attached 📸'. Falls back to '🚗' when no proof — validated by both tests.

server.py:6660-6699 care-team parent POST — empty check `if not text and not body.photo_url and not body.audio_url: raise 400`. Persists photo_url + audio_url + audio_dur into db.care_team_messages ONLY (no leaks to db.messages / db.helper_messages). care_msg_public at 6664-6668 exposes audio_url/audio_dur/photo_url. Same shape mirrored at 7104-7124 for helper POST.

helper-portal/index.tsx:335 portal-checkin button conditionally renders when !checkin?.checked_in_at, and after check-in the '🟢 On duty since HH:MM' text is shown (line 342). CareTeamChatView.tsx:269/276/304 render careteam-rec-cancel/careteam-rec-send/careteam-mic correctly gated by recording state + empty input.

context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) Phase-5 backend surface (server.py): (a) HELPER MEDIA TOKEN generated by make_helper_media_token (line 6097) with account_type='helper_media'; returned by POST /api/helper/login (line 6853), POST /api/helper/pin (6863) and GET /api/helper/dashboard (6899). Served by GET /api/files/{path}?token=... which dispatches to _serve_file_for_helper (5210) — allow-list is {owner_id==helper_id, care_team_messages photo/audio, helper_messages photo/audio}; anything else 404s. (b) DROP-OFF proof at helper_task_trip line 6978-7002 — trip.proof_url stored on stage=reached; 📸 notification fires when proof_url present. (c) CHECK-IN / CHECK-OUT at 7155-7183 — date-scoped upsert with idempotent behaviour; POST /helper/checkin second-call returns same checked_in_at without new notif. (d) CARE-TEAM audio/photo at 6660-6699 (parent) and 7104-7124 (helper) — both accept audio_url+audio_dur+photo_url, empty 400s; care_msg_public at 6664 exposes those fields. (e) parent list_helpers (6282) and get_helper (6348) now inject checked_in_at/checked_out_at from db.helper_checkins for the current UTC date. (f) parent helper_activity (6571) surfaces trip.proof_url as part of the completion row. 2) FRONTEND testIDs: helper-portal/index.tsx — portal-shift (line 342 area), portal-checkin (line 335, conditional on !checked_in_at), portal-careteam-btn, trip-reached-<task_id> (line 493). helper/[id].tsx — helper-onduty (line 222, conditional on checked_in_at && !checked_out_at), arrival-proof-<task_id> (line 372, conditional on tripByTask[t.task_id]?.proof_url). CareTeamChatView.tsx — careteam-mic (304), careteam-rec-send (276), careteam-rec-cancel (269), ctphoto-<mid> (233), ctvoice-<mid> (238). (tabs)/family.tsx — '🟢 On duty' pill (275) tied to h.on_duty (backend list_helpers computes this). 3) The pytest suite creates 2 real uploads via /helper/upload and 2 via /upload — cleanup is at DB level for care_team_messages / helper_messages / messages / vault_items but NOT for the media files themselves (they're small ~15-30 bytes JPEGs). If accumulation ever concerns, wipe with `db.media.delete_many({content_type:'image/jpeg', kind:'image', 'storage_path': {'$regex':'helper_uploads|uploads'}})` — this is not needed after each run. 4) The 'I've arrived' UI button (portal-checkin) will not appear if Sunita has already checked in today; to demo it, wipe db.helper_checkins for today first. 5) The DropOff Playwright walk-through (Start Trip → Picked Up → Reached with camera) is native-only — the network round-trips are what the backend suite verifies (proof_url persistence + 📸 notification). 6) A transient 15s connection timeout was seen ONCE on our-story-191.preview.emergentagent.com during test 2 (test_helper_post_audio) — retry passed immediately. Bump `timeout=15` to `timeout=30` if intermittent connectivity is a problem in your environment.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found in Phase 5. Media-token allow-list correctly restricts helpers to their own uploads + care-team-referenced + 1:1-helper-thread-referenced files (validated via 4 positive and 4 negative access probes including Family Chat and Vault); check-in idempotency is verified by scanning /api/notifications for the 🟢 count and asserting same checked_in_at on repeat call; drop-off proof round-trip is verified end-to-end through /helper/tasks/{id}/trip → db.helper_task_completions.trip.proof_url → GET /helpers/{id}/activity → 📸 parent notification.
